dedupe_keys.name: transport starter data kits historical socio transport data by country

description: The Transport Starter Data Kits are a series of country datasets on Zenodo; the records read are mostly for African countries, such as Malawi, Mozambique, Algeria, Djibouti, Somalia and the Central African Republic. Each kit contains historical annual data from 1990 to 2021 on passenger and freight activity by mode and fuel, with energy intensities, load factors, vehicle stock, population (total, urban, rural and growth) and GDP by sector, and a spreadsheet with data, definitions and notes on the status of each observation; the sources are linked where possible. The data were verified in consultation with stakeholders before publication in December 2023, and each kit comes as an XLSX workbook with a PDF summary. Access: free downloads under CC BY 4.0; a Zenodo search finds about 60 records in the series, including versions. Caveats: observations differ in status, as recorded in each kit's notes, and the data are national totals without network detail. It supports transport demand baselines for energy-transport and scenario models and freight and passenger capacity planning in data-poor countries, and complements the Eurostat transport statistics catalogued here.
name: Transport Starter Data Kits, historical socio-transport data by country
